ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Allied Digital Services Limited (ADSL) has granted 200,000 employee stock options under its ESOP 2020, with an exercise price of INR 114 per option, compliant with SEBI regulations. This move represents a potential future equity dilution for existing shareholders if fully exercised, while also generating INR 22.8 million in cash for the company and serving as an employee incentive. The immediate financial impact on diluted earnings per share is not provided in this specific disclosure.
